cases.title: Delegation needs the issuer and Control to agree
cases.when: Four requests: issuer-delegated token with a DELEGATED binding covering the user; issuer-delegated token with a SERVICE binding; DELEGATED binding not covering the user; a client-credentials token claiming a user in arguments
then: Only the first is accepted as DELEGATED
The others are refused with the same error as an unknown identity

cases.title: A delegation rule or delegatedUserId covers the user
cases.when: A DELEGATED binding is configured with delegatedUserId, then with a rule matching a group of users
then: Users covered are accepted; others are refused

cases.title: SERVICE mode has no user
cases.when: A SERVICE token carries a sub that looks like a user
then: RequestContext has mode SERVICE and no userId
jwt().getUserName() is empty in the tool
